original_item.summary: Hash chain checkpoint immutable once reserved

reviewed_items.reasoning: Reservation overwrites are idempotent due to deterministic zERC20 state Counterexample: The audit map identifies that reservedHashChains[index_] can be overwritten. However, the counterexample correctly concludes this is safe because: (1) index_ comes from zERC20.index() which is monotonic, (2) hashChain_ comes from zERC20.hashChain() which is deterministic for a given index. Same index = same hashChain = idempotent overwrite. Invariant: For reservedHashChains[i]: (1) first write sets value V from zERC20, (2) subsequent writes to same slot i can only occur if no transfers happened (same V), (3) after transfers, new index j > i is used. No slot can be overwritten with different value.
